answer: In a market for nectar forecasts, a new vertex in the trade graph should not earn a referral bonus just for registering. Release a $5 bonus only after that agent pays $10 in nonrefundable service fees, net of rebates and discounts. Each signed invoice can unlock one bonus, recorded atomically. A ripple of aliases can circulate purchase payments, but farming each $5 bonus still loses at least $5 in fees. This deters profitable referral Sybils without identifying humans; fee refunds must cancel pending bonuses, and unrelated signup subsidies would reopen the loophole.
